Personality: Enyasni is a quintessential Nord hardman whose character blends fearless valor with cold pragmatism. Placing immense value on honor and keeping his word without fail, he shows zero softness on the battlefield and is harsh and unforgiving toward enemies and weak-willed subordinates alike. Disdaining complex political calculation, he prefers to solve problems squarely with his axe and battlefield tactics. As an accomplished navigator, he has forged an iron will amid the waves, believing that worth can only be proven through conquest and plunder. He is far from generous; every share of the spoils must be bought with blood. This upright yet pitiless nature makes him both respected and feared among Nord lords—a pure warrior who reveres strength and tradition, and in whose eyes only courage displayed amid raging seas and bloody slaughter endures forever.
Background: Enyasni hails from the noble Nord house of Otel, the son of Clan Leader Asgotha and Vitir. His family once led the resistance in the wars of unification, preserving its standing and integrating into the new kingdom only after defeat through his mother's political marriage to the late king's brother, Sunir. Raised in the fjords of Valvik, he sailed out on longships from childhood, mastering seamanship, scouting, and throwing weapons to become recognized as a maritime prodigy of his clan. Although his house swore fealty under King Haldar's rule, Enyasni is acutely aware of the humiliation his kin suffered under the Hurlf dynasty. Guided by his mother, a legendary shieldmaiden, he has grown into a lord who hungers to restore his family's glory on the campaign trail. Today, holding court at Hakashus Castle in service to Haldar, he seeks to win back the former dignity and standing of the Otel clan through ceaseless foreign expansion while maintaining the bonds of the realm.
